## Agent + governance surfaces [REPORTED 2026-07-06 — still present, no new entity types this scan]:
- **Agents API**: projects.locations.agents (create/list/get/patch/delete).
- **Semantic Governance**: projects.locations.semanticGovernancePolicies (CRUD); projects.locations.semanticGovernancePolicyEngine (get/update/deprovision).
- **Reasoning Engines**: projects.locations.reasoningEngines + .runtimeRevisions + .sessions + .sessions.events; ops query/streamQuery/asyncQuery/cancelAsyncQuery.
- **Agent Studio** — visual agent builder (docs component).

## Core API Resources (cached, still present)
- REST v1 / v1beta1; SDK refs (Python, Go, Node.js, Java, C#); gcloud ai / beta ai.
- Publishers.models (generateContent, countTokens, embed, predict, streaming).
- Endpoints (generateContent, predict, explain, deploy, streaming).
- RAG Corpora & RAG Files; retrieveContexts / asyncRetrieveContexts / askContexts; RAG Engine Config.
- Cached Contents; Feature Stores / Groups / Online Stores; fetchFeatureValues.
- Metadata Stores (artifacts, contexts, executions).
- Pipeline Jobs, Custom Jobs, Training Pipelines, Tuning Jobs, Batch Prediction Jobs, Hyperparameter Tuning Jobs.
- Datasets & Data Items; Index Endpoints & Indexes; searchNearestEntities (vector search).
- Deployment Resource Pools; Persistent Resources; Schedules; Specialist Pools; Studies & Trials; Tensorboards.
- Notebook Execution & Runtime Management; Model Deployment Monitoring; Model Evaluations.
- Long-running operations; media upload; prompt augmentation & corroboration; instance evaluation.
